title: Gate verdict block
x-version-note: MAJOR bump 2026-08-07 (v1->v2): added the 'COULD NOT ASSESS' verdict value (blocking, reason-required) per AGENT-SPEC-v3 §7. The verdict schema is a declared interface (AGENT-SPEC §12.4); this is a coordinated major version across all plugins.
description: R11: the single machine-parseable verdict every gate agent emits, fenced as a ```verdict code block, alongside its human-readable prose. Replaces the five incompatible vocabularies (APPROVE/CONDITIONS/BLOCK, READY/ACTIONS/BLOCK, PASS/NEEDS WORK, APPROVE/CHANGES, PASS/CONCERNS/FAIL) with one. The orchestrator's validator (validate_verdict.py) and the change-record-required CI check both parse it.

gate.description: the gate this verdict fills, e.g. 'security', 'privacy', 'tests', 'review'

agent.description: the gate agent that produced it, e.g. 'security-architect'

artifact.description: what was reviewed — PR ref and/or file/diff range

verdict.description: PASS = accept-eligible; CONCERNS = accept with the listed conditions met; FAIL = rework, or a §5 human risk-acceptance to overrule; N/A = gate does not apply (reason required); COULD NOT ASSESS = the gate ran but could not complete its assessment (timeout, context exhausted on a large artifact, or a required tool missing) — reason required; completion-auditor treats it as BLOCKING, never neutral

evidence.description: each item cites file:line or a concrete basis — no-evidence items are dropped; each must be non-blank (\S), so a whitespace-only string does not pass as evidence

falsifier.description: the single fact or test that, if true, would flip this verdict — must be non-blank (\S), not just spaces

conditions.description: specific, testable conditions to clear — REQUIRED (non-empty) when verdict is CONCERNS or FAIL

reason.description: one line of why — REQUIRED when verdict is N/A (an unexplained N/A is a rubber stamp) or COULD NOT ASSESS (what blocked the assessment)
